scope: Evaluate exactly the single frozen external replication contrast in research/m2-type-i-external-replication-prereg-v1.json. No alternate threshold, endpoint, subgroup or symbol subset may replace the primary test.
closeout: The one-time external replication has been consumed. Future CI may verify the frozen result but must not recompute or rerun this replication set for iterative tuning.
reopen_policy: Do not reopen the 60-symbol external replication dataset. Any new confirmatory replication requires a separately frozen disjoint dataset or prospectively advanced snapshot and a new preregistration.
